name: Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager – The Ultimate Free WordPress Book Catalogue Plugin
author: librarysol

sections.description:
Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager is a powerful, free, all-in-one WordPress book catalogue and book gallery plugin designed for authors, publishers, public and school libraries, book bloggers, collectors, and book-related businesses. Whether you’re creating a beautiful book showcase, organizing a personal library, or publishing a searchable online book catalogue, Librarysol gives your books a professional home on WordPress.

Add unlimited books, authors, categories, genres, and series, display responsive galleries, and help visitors discover titles with search, filtering, sorting, and dedicated book pages — without a licence, usage quota, or required paid add-on.

🚀 Key Features

✔ Unlimited Books & Authors
Build a collection of any size. Add as many books, authors, categories, genres, and series as you need, with no artificial catalogue limits.

✔ Beautiful Book Galleries
Showcase your titles in responsive grid and list layouts, complete with book covers and individual book pages.

✔ Search, Filters & Sorting
Make large collections easier to explore with book search, basic filters, sorting, and pagination.

✔ Detailed Book Information
Create informative book profiles with title, cover, author, ISBN, publisher, publication year, page count, language, description, edition, and format.

✔ Authors, Genres, Categories & Series
Keep your collection organized and help readers discover books by the writers and subjects they enjoy.

✔ Gutenberg Book Gallery Block
Add customizable book grids using the built-in Book Catalogue Gallery block in the WordPress editor.

✔ Flexible Shortcode Support
Place your book catalogue in supported pages and posts without writing code.

✔ Easy Book Import
Add books manually, use basic CSV import when enabled in the plugin tools, or work with supported JSON import options.

✔ Multilingual & Translation-Ready
Use bundled language packs, local translation import/export, and a translation-ready interface to reach more readers.

✔ Privacy-Conscious by Design
No telemetry or usage tracking in the free plugin. Bundled translations work locally, and the plugin does not request Google Fonts.

Whether you’re an independent author showcasing a new release, a librarian organizing thousands of titles, or a collector sharing your favorite books, Librarysol gives you the freedom to build a professional catalogue your way.

🔄 Tired of Your Current WordPress Book Catalogue Plugin?

Looking for a better, easier, and completely free alternative to your existing WordPress book catalogue plugin?

Switching to Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager is easier than ever! If you’re currently using RS WP Book Showcase or WP Books Gallery, you can migrate your existing book collection in just a few clicks — without starting from scratch!

✔ One-Click Book Catalogue Migration
Easily transfer your existing books to Librarysol with our built-in migration tools.

✔ Migrate from Popular WordPress Book Plugins
Seamlessly migrate your book catalogue from RS WP Book Showcase and WP Books Gallery.

✔ Keep Your Existing Book Collection
Save time by transferring supported book information instead of manually recreating your catalogue.

✔ Unlimited Books, Unlimited Possibilities
Manage as many books, authors, categories, genres, and series as you need — without artificial limits.

✔ Beautiful & Responsive Book Galleries
Give your existing book collection a fresh, professional appearance with modern grid and list layouts.

✔ 100% Free Migration
No migration fees, no premium licence, and no hidden charges. Switch to Librarysol completely free!

🚀 Why settle for limitations when you can have more for free?

Migrate from RS WP Book Showcase or WP Books Gallery to Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager today and experience a smarter, more flexible way to manage your WordPress book collection!

📚 Try Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager – Completely FREE!

📚 Features Comparison

✅ Included Free — No Catalogue Limits

  • Unlimited Books — no book-count restrictions
  • Unlimited Authors — organize your collection by writer
  • Unlimited Categories, Genres & Series — build a logical, browsable catalogue
  • Grid Book Gallery — present covers in an attractive visual layout
  • List Catalogue Layout — offer an alternative browsing experience
  • Dedicated Single Book Pages — give every title its own profile
  • Book Covers & Descriptions — showcase what makes every book special
  • Bibliographic Fields — ISBN, publisher, year, pages, language, edition, format, and more
  • Book Search — make titles easier to find
  • Basic Filters — help readers narrow the selection
  • Sorting & Pagination — keep browsing manageable as your collection grows
  • Responsive Frontend Layouts — present your catalogue across screen sizes
  • Gutenberg Book Gallery Block — insert book grids in the block editor
  • Shortcodes — place catalogues in supported WordPress content
  • Basic CSV Import — available when enabled in plugin tools
  • Bundled Language Packs — use local translation resources
  • Translation Import/Export — manage supported local translations
  • Website-Solution Presets — use the presets bundled with the plugin
  • No Licence or Paid Add-On Required — all functionality bundled in the free plugin remains available

🔧 Optional Integrations & Extended Use Cases

  • WooCommerce-Related Features — available where supported; WooCommerce must be installed for functions that depend on it
  • Optional QR-Code Images — where enabled, generated using the disclosed external QR image service
  • Optional Affiliate-Link Health Checks — check configured retailer URLs when enabled
  • JSON URL Import — retrieve a JSON file explicitly selected by an authorized site administrator

Important: These items are not a separate Pro-feature list. They describe options or integrations associated with the plugin. Some require another plugin or contact an external service, as detailed in the WordPress.org listing.

📖 Explore Librarysol Features
📥 Get Librarysol Free on WordPress.org

🎯 Who Is Librarysol For?

✔ Authors & Writers
Showcase your books, organize titles into series, and give each publication its own dedicated page.

✔ Publishers & Literary Websites
Build a searchable directory of published titles, authors, genres, and editions.

✔ Public & School Libraries
Present collections in a structured, reader-friendly online catalogue.

✔ Bookstores & Book Businesses
Help visitors browse book information and use supported integrations as your website grows.

✔ Book Bloggers & Reviewers
Create a book directory that complements your reviews, recommendations, and literary content.

✔ Book Collectors & Reading Communities
Organize a personal collection or build a resource dedicated to a genre, author, or literary community.

📚 Documentation & Getting Started

Install and Create Your First Catalogue

  1. Install Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin and open its administration menu.
  3. Add books, covers, authors, descriptions, and publication details.
  4. Organize your books with categories, genres, and series.
  5. Add the book gallery Gutenberg block or a supported shortcode to your page.
  6. Publish your catalogue and let readers explore your books.

Useful Links

  • 📌 Official Librarysol Website
  • 📌 WordPress.org Plugin Page
  • 📌 Installation Instructions
  • 📌 Support Forum

🚀 Why Choose Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager?

✔ A Complete Free Catalogue — Not a Restricted Demo
Create a practical, fully usable WordPress book catalogue without paying to unlock essential built-in features.

✔ Unlimited Room to Grow
From a handful of books to a large collection, your catalogue isn’t restricted by arbitrary book or author limits.

✔ Professional Presentation
Responsive galleries, dedicated book pages, and structured metadata help your collection look consistent and easy to browse.

✔ Designed for More Than One Type of Website
Use Librarysol for authors’ portfolios, publishers’ catalogues, library collections, school projects, and community book directories.

✔ Simple WordPress Publishing
Manage books in the WordPress dashboard and add book galleries with a Gutenberg block or shortcode.

✔ Privacy-Conscious Core
The free plugin does not send usage telemetry, and bundled language packs do not require an external translation service.

✔ Open-Source WordPress Plugin
Use a plugin available through the official WordPress.org plugin directory, with public source and a community support forum.

Unlimited books. Beautiful catalogues. More ways to discover great reading.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Is Librarysol Book Catalogue Manager really free?

Yes. The plugin’s built-in catalogue functionality is available without a licence, commercial account, or paid add-on.

Can I add unlimited books and authors?

Yes. There are no artificial limits on the number of books, authors, categories, genres, or series you can create.

Can visitors search and filter my book catalogue?

Yes. Librarysol includes book search, basic filters, sorting, and pagination.

Can I display my books in a gallery?

Yes. You can choose grid or list layouts and use the Gutenberg Book Catalogue Gallery block or supported shortcodes.

Which information can I include for each book?

Book profiles can include title, cover, author, ISBN, publisher, publication year, number of pages, language, description, edition, and format.

Can I use the plugin for a school or public library?

Yes. Librarysol can present a searchable online catalogue for libraries and educational collections. It does not, by itself, imply a complete library circulation or loan-management system.

Is Librarysol compatible with WooCommerce?

The plugin includes website-solution functionality that can work with WooCommerce where supported. WooCommerce must be installed for integration features that rely on it.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. Librarysol is translation-ready and includes bundled language packs and local translation import/export tools.

Does the plugin track visitor usage?

The free plugin does not send telemetry or usage tracking data. Optional external-service features are separately disclosed in the plugin description.

📚 Every book deserves to be discovered. Build your catalogue with Librarysol today!
sections.changelog:
2.6.155

  • Escape template and wrapper return values with the catalogue HTML allowlist, including series and friend-loan callbacks, while preserving forms, icons, and illustrations.
  • Initialize missing layout settings without resetting saved choices on reactivation; preserve legacy settings before migration.
  • Handle malformed legacy role settings during activation and restrict frontend/editor assets and sortable dependencies to catalogue contexts.

2.6.154

  • Verify JSON import and support action nonces directly from POST, independently of query-string, cookie, or combined request values.
  • Restrict support submissions and attachment uploads to POST and retain separate capability checks.
  • Bind webstore saves to the native or custom editor context selected by the caller, without inferring nonce actions from submitted fields.

2.6.153

  • Normalize upload fields directly with field-specific sanitizers; reject malformed upload metadata and unsafe temporary paths before reading files.
  • Escape the complete catalogue-sizing rule at the inline stylesheet boundary without changing theme header or footer sizing.

2.6.152

  • Verify the JSON import form explicitly and reject unauthorized, malformed, or non-JSON attachment requests before importing.
  • Restore the JSON import handler’s connection to the bundled import function.
  • Verify each support-upload and book-editor nonce in its own request context.
  • Sanitize store-link payloads at input without changing encoded URL components or repeatedly unslashing stored values.
  • Validate uploaded-file metadata, canonical temporary paths, actual file sizes, and PHP upload provenance.
  • Preserve current and legacy affiliate links while restricting redirects and analytics labels to the book’s registered offers.
  • Apply AJAX language tokens only to their matching catalogue-filter action and sanitize inline sizing CSS at output.

2.6.151

  • Prepare complete catalogue-page and metadata-search queries with all values bound together.
  • Correct dynamic placeholder lists in dashboard counts, library filters, and migration queries.
  • Escape custom table identifiers directly where queries are prepared.
  • Use a safe dashboard redirect and preserve the main query when slider and widget loops finish.

2.6.150

  • Make every bundled website solution, preset, and manual Goodreads field available without add-on flags.
  • Bundle local language packs and correct the QR service terms and privacy links.
  • Strengthen action nonces, permission checks, request validation, upload handling, and frontend output escaping.
  • Escape slider data attributes individually and preserve accessible form controls during HTML sanitization.
  • Prefix plugin lifecycle and REST hooks, declare setting sanitizers explicitly, and avoid loading the core admin plugin API.
  • Preserve the existing theme header, footer, and catalogue layout behavior.

2.6.149

  • Extend the restored theme layout compatibility to series, publisher, author, illustrator, translator, category, and catalogue archive pages.

2.6.148

  • Restore the removed Newsy boxed-layout compatibility classes on single-book pages, including child themes.

2.6.147

  • Preserve the active theme’s header, footer, and outer wrapper dimensions on catalogue pages.
  • Scope catalogue sizing settings to plugin content instead of the document root.

2.6.146

  • Restore the original plugin entry filename with complete plugin metadata.
  • Correct internal entry-file references and refresh the submission packages.

2.6.72

  • Confirmed unlimited books in the free plugin.
  • Removed legacy commercial-account checks from free functionality.
  • Removed legacy marketplace automation from the free plugin.
  • Removed bundled updater/account-service code from the free plugin.
  • Moved optional commercial features to separate add-on architecture.
  • Improved WordPress.org compliance for settings, external-service disclosure and privacy.
